name: Hemingway Editor
tagline: Hemingway Editor highlights complex sentences, passive voice, unnecessary adverbs, and hard-to-read passages in colour, pushing writers toward clearer, more direct prose. Its AI rewrite feature can simplify flagged sentences with a click, and a readability grade tracks overall clarity as you write. Writers, journalists, and content teams use it to make their writing scannable and direct without losing their voice.
